styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean #F7F6F2 studio field, optional faint grid-paper info panel in #FFFFFF, one low rounded podium, botanical sprig corner accents; no scenic backdrops
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft 5500K studio light, front-left key, gentle bounce fill, low-contrast soft contact shadows that always ground the product
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF podium and pale matte counter, no mirror reflection, no wet gloss
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif Chinese, one family only; headline 32-44pt in #2D2D2D, pill sub-label 14-16pt in #FFFFFF on an #4A5B3C block, chip label 10-14pt; no serif, no handwritten, no cartoon faces
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline line icons inside hairline circles, glyph drawn in #4A5B3C, uniform stroke, paw-and-bone used only as tiny corner ornaments
styleLock.presentationRules: product stays upright with the pump head fully inside frame and the label plane facing the camera; hero angle held consistent across all screens; animal always beside or behind the product and never occluding the label; identical scale and vertical placement
noDrift: no source brand marks or on-image store assets
no QR codes, barcodes, membership or contact blocks
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium botanical pet-grooming ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of studio field #F7F6F2, podium and panel #FFFFFF, text #2D2D2D and one accent #4A5B3C; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif Chinese typography, one family only, no serif and no handwritten faces; consistent thin single-weight hairline line icons inside hairline circles drawn in #4A5B3C; background system of a clean #F7F6F2 studio field with an optional faint grid-paper panel in #FFFFFF, one low rounded podium and botanical sprig corner accents; lighting system of bright soft 5500K studio light, front-left key, gentle bounce fill, low-contrast soft contact shadows grounding every object; matte #FFFFFF podium and pale matte counter surfaces, no mirror reflection; stable product scale, upright framing with the pump head fully visible and the label plane facing the camera, animal never covering the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no source brand marks, no QR code.

shots.intent: 详情页首屏一眼说清品类与温和主张，接住从主图点进来的流量。
shots.camera: eye-level front 3/4 view, full product visible standing upright on a low podium, calm dog seated at frame left beside it
shots.lighting: bright soft 5500K key from front-left with gentle bounce fill, low-contrast soft contact shadow under bottle base and paw pads
shots.background: #F7F6F2 seamless studio field with a #FFFFFF low rounded podium and one botanical sprig at each top corner
shots.props: two hairline circle line-icon badges, botanical sprigs in the top corners, one seated dog
shots.whitespace: top headline band only, no side margins
shots.textZone: 顶部中央横排主标题区，其下一枚胶囊副标区，左侧两枚圆形线描图标配短标签区
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail-page hero screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level front 3/4 view, full product upright on a low #FFFFFF rounded podium, a calm dog seated at frame left beside it and never covering the label plane. Bright soft 5500K key from front-left with gentle bounce fill, low-contrast soft contact shadow grounding both the base and the paws. Seamless #F7F6F2 studio field, one botanical sprig at each top corner. Product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Text zones: top-centre headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 40pt, one pill sub-label 「{callout_1}」 at 15pt, two hairline circle line icons with short labels 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 at 12pt. shots.lighting: even flat 5500K studio light on the icon plane, soft front-left key inside the lower photo card
shots.background: #FFFFFF faint grid-paper panel over a #F7F6F2 page field
shots.props: six hairline circle icons in a 3x2 grid, one framed photo card, one solid accent chip block
shots.textZone: 顶部标题区与胶囊副标区，六枚图标正下方各一行短标签区，右下角块强调标签区
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic benefit-grid screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat infographic plane, no perspective tilt: a 3x2 grid of six hairline circle line icons on a faint grid-paper #FFFFFF panel over a #F7F6F2 page, and below it one rectangular photo card showing the product at a slight 3/4 angle beside a dog. shots.intent: 用居家可见的毛发与气味困扰放大痛点，引出洗护需求。

shots.lighting: lower-key directional light on the problem side, brighter soft 5500K fill on the solution side, shadows falling the same way in both panels
shots.background: real home corner with a #F7F6F2 wall and a fabric sofa surface, then a clean #FFFFFF podium on the right panel
shots.props: loose fur on fabric, muddy paw marks on a light floor, folded towel, the product at the right edge
shots.textZone: 左侧一行痛点胶囊标签区，右侧留净不置字
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Text zone: one pain-point pill label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 14pt on the left panel, right panel kept clear. Vertical 3:4 crop. Negative: no fabricated statistics, no numbers, no exaggerated filth, no deformed paws, no duplicated dog, no brand name, no watermark, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 由 8 张详情页切片提炼，L1「宠物用品」与源文件夹一致，L2 判为「美容」（洗护类，库内既有宠物版未覆盖该 L2）。已剥离：瓶身标签字样、水印站名与站名占位文案（产品名称/产地单元格）、会员促销文字与二维码、具体克数与 pH 数值、犬只个体特征（改为 generic dog，不指向源犬只/品种身份）。全部数值与主张改为 {callout_*}/{selling_point_*} 占位符，未新增任何认证、检测数据或功效表述。
